description: This Java source file defines a simple Android ContentProvider named FileProvider that serves asset files from within an APK. It implements methods to query file metadata, open files, and transfer data through pipes, primarily for serving files such as APKs to clients.

classes.name: FileProvider
classes.description: A simple ContentProvider that serves asset files from the APK, allowing clients to query file metadata and open files through a pipe.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the content provider, returning true to indicate successful creation.

methods.name: query
methods.description: Provides metadata about files, such as display name and size, based on the requested URI and projection columns.

methods.name: insert
methods.description: Does not support insert operations, returns null.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Does not support delete operations, returns 0.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Does not support update operations, returns 0.

methods.name: getType
methods.description: Returns the MIME type for the files served, assumed to be APKs with 'application/vnd.android.package-archive'.

methods.name: openFile
methods.description: Opens an asset file for the given URI by parsing the URI path, extracting the asset, and returning a ParcelFileDescriptor to read its contents.

methods.name: writeDataToPipe
methods.description: Transfers data from an InputStream (asset) to the PipeOutputStream, effectively piping the file contents for client access.
